Privacy Policy for SKiL MATRiX Notes

Effective Date: February 1, 2026

At SKiL MATRiX Notes, we are committed to protecting your privacy and providing a safe, secure experience for all visitors and users of our website, regardless of where you reside.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following information:

  • Personal Information: Name, email address, academic details (college, branch, year), and authentication data when you sign up or log in.
  • Academic & Tracking Data: Records of your lecture attendance (Attendance Pro), target and actual SGPA/CGPA (CGPA Analyzer), notes bookmarked, study schedules, and Pomodoro focus sessions (NeuroSprint Pro).
  • AI Interactions: Text queries, prompts, and document context submitted to our AI tools (AI Coach, Model Paper Generator).
  • Financial Information: For premium subscriptions (CodeTantra Hub, Premium Scholar), we collect transaction IDs, subscription status, and billing history. We do not store full credit card details.
  • Usage & Device Data: Interactions on the site, IP addresses, browser types, and device information using Firebase and Google Analytics.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use collected information to:

  • Provide, maintain, and personalize our services and dashboard features.
  • Process payments and manage premium subscriptions.
  • Generate AI-driven responses, study plans, and model papers based on your input.
  • Analyze usage trends and improve educational resources.
  • Ensure security, monitor for fraud, and enforce our terms of service.

3. Third-Party Services and Integrations

To provide advanced features, we share necessary data with trusted third parties:

  • AI Providers: User queries and syllabus context are sent to industry-leading third-party artificial intelligence models to power our AI Coach and Paper Generators securely.
  • Payment Processors: We use Razorpay to handle subscription payments securely. They collect and process your payment information according to their own privacy policies.
  • Infrastructure: Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and Cloud Functions are used for data storage and backend operations.
  • Analytics & Ads: Google Analytics and Google AdSense are used to track site performance and display relevant advertisements.

4. Data Security & Retention

We implement reasonable security safeguards, including encryption, to protect your information. We retain your academic, usage, and subscription data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services, resolve disputes, and comply with legal obligations.

5. Children's Privacy

SKiL MATRiX Notes is intended for college and university students. Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

6. Your Rights

You may request to access, correct, export, or delete your personal and academic information by contacting us at skilmatrix3@gmail.com. You may also manage your privacy preferences and delete data directly from your account settings.

7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy at any time to reflect changes in our features or legal requirements. We will post the updated policy on this page with a revised “Effective Date.”

Contact us if you have any questions or concerns regarding your privacy: skilmatrix3@gmail.com
